title: Amazingly Creamy Portuguese Farfalle Pasta
description: This dish features farfalle pasta in a creamy malty sauce with a shio-koji cure, perfect for a Whole30-friendly meal prep option.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the farfalle pasta according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
In a small bowl, mix the shio-koji with a little water to create a paste, then add it to the skillet and stir to combine.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the coconut cream and let the sauce simmer for an additional 5 minutes.
Season the sauce with salt and black pepper to taste.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet, tossing to combine with the sauce.
Serve the pasta hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
